event_name: TWØBAYS: The Gluten-Free Rooftop Takeover | Beer Week Grand Final
date_text: Sun, Oct 25th • 12:00 PM AEDT - Sun, Oct 25th • 10:00 PM AEDT
description: THE FINAL DAY. 12 TAPS. 100% GLUTEN-FREE BEER. $1,000 ON THE LINE. LET’S FINISH SYDNEY BEER WEEK PROPERLY. For the final day of Sydney Beer Week, Hotel Sweeney’s is throwing open the rooftop taps to our mates from Melbourne — TWØBAYS Brewing Co. And when we say takeover, we mean it. 🍺 12 TAPS. 100% GLUTEN-FREE. That’s right — all 12 rooftop taps pouring gluten-free beer from TWØBAYS. Their last takeover at Sweeney’s saw kegs popping on the same day, and year after year this remains one of our most talked-about events — bringing together the gluten-free and coeliac community for something that can be pretty hard to find: A rooftop pub with an entire tap lineup of gluten-free beer. And this year, we’re going even bigger. With TWØBAYS opening their new Melbourne bar, we’ll have access to some of their exclusive taproom-only beers, making their way north to Sweeney’s especially for Sydney Beer Week. 🌞 ROOFTOP OPEN FROM 10AM Why wait until lunch? For the final day of Beer Week, we’re opening the Sweeney’s rooftop from 10AM, giving you plenty of time to grab a spot, work your way through the taps and settle in for the day. 🍽️ GLUTEN-FREE BEER. GLUTEN-FREE FOOD. The kitchen will be open with gluten-free meals available to order alongside your beers. Come hungry. Come thirsty. Make a day of it. 🏆 THE SWEENEY’S BEER WEEK OLYMPICS GRAND FINAL Then at 2PM, things get serious. After nine nights of ridiculous challenges, gold coins, chocolate wheels, questionable sporting ability and glorious victories, our nightly champions return to Hotel Sweeney’s for one final showdown. THE CORNHOLE GRAND FINAL. Nine nights. Nine winners. One sudden-death competition. One champion. And one enormous prize: A $1,000 HOTEL SWEENEY’S BAR TAB. Our finalists will need their beanbags ready and their finest wrist action dialled in, because when you’re out, you’re out. Last person standing takes the lot. 🌾 COELIAC? GLUTEN-FREE? OR JUST LOVE GREAT BEER? This is your day. TWØBAYS always brings an incredible crowd to Sweeney’s, and whether you’re coeliac, gluten-aware, bringing along someone who is, or simply keen to try some cracking Australian beer, everyone is welcome on the rooftop. Sydney Beer Week has given us nine massive nights. Now there’s only one thing left to do. Fill the taps. Fill the rooftop. Throw some beanbags. Crown a champion. 12 TAPS. 100% GLUTEN-FREE. $1,000 UP FOR GRABS. ONE LAST SUNDAY. LET’S GO!
